title: Core coherent algebraization on a fixed projective modification
statement: Let A be a commutative Noetherian ring complete for an ideal I, Z a Noetherian scheme, and f : Z → Spec A separated and of finite type. Let Q = I O_Z and G a coherent formal Q-module with degree-zero support proper over A. Given a proper q : Y → Z, n : ℕ, an immersion e of Y into P^n_A, and equality of its projection with q ≫ f, there exists a coherent module F on Y whose Q.comap q completion is isomorphic to the tensor pullback of G and whose support is proper over Spec A.

proof.text: Obtain F, a proper Noetherian compactification P, an open immersion j, the restriction and completion isomorphisms, and closed-fibre support containment from new-chow-algebraization-core-support-data. Apply the corrected support theorem to P and j, then rewrite j composed with p as q composed with f. Return the completion isomorphism and proper support.

theorem exists_chow_algebraization_core
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] (f : Z ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (Q : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (hQ : Q = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Z Q)
    (hR : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.obj.obj (op 0)))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper q] (n : ℕ)
    (e : Y ⟶ ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) (Spec (.of A)))
    [IsImmersion e]
    (he : e ≫ (ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A)) =
      q ≫ f) :
    ∃ F : CoherentModules Y,
      Nonempty (G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (Q.comap q) F.obj) ∧
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver (q ≫ f) F.obj
